candidates.review_note: The composition remains an additive shift clamped between two bounds. Update these three values for every operation, then answer each query once.

A proposed occurrence must match all fixed letters. Compatible earlier occurrences either do not overlap or differ by a period of the pattern. DP over occurrence starts maximizes the count while enforcing every overlapping consistency constraint.
Accumulate digit counts while enumerating 1 through the largest requested n, storing only requested prefix totals and preserving input case order.

Check the stated universal condition on every nontrivial divisor pair; sieve primality up to the explicit bound. One and primes satisfy the empty-divisor condition without adding an unstated composite-only restriction.

Each output must contain exactly two distinct symbols. Four distinct symbols partition directly; three require a repeated shared symbol; two require at least two copies of each. Other distinct-count cases are impossible.
Compute x^(m-1) modulo the recurrence characteristic polynomial with binary exponentiation, then apply the resulting linear combination to the correctly reversed initial conditions.

The stated global price range yields four price classes. For a chosen count from a class take its highest importance items; enumerate counts in three classes and optimally fill the fourth using nonnegative importance.

Project the point onto each segment, clamp its parameter to [0,1], and retain the globally nearest candidate. Degenerate segments reduce to their endpoint and output uses the sample four-decimal convention.
Tokenize the two-character brackets as single positions, use a stack for the five matched kinds, and report the first wrong closing token or the end-of-input position when opens remain.

A perfect matching of an even square gives the first player a pairing strategy. For an odd square the board with the starting corner removed has a perfect matching, giving the second player the corresponding response strategy.
Every maximal vowel run keeps its first vowel; stream the string while suppressing later adjacent vowels and retain the explicitly included y.
An integer is simultaneously a square and a cube exactly when it is a sixth power. Integer binary search avoids floating-point root and rounding errors.
Uniqueness follows from binary representation; excluding 2^0 makes precisely the odd inputs impossible, and set bits give the descending decomposition.

For week lengths below n, each starting column gives one distinct connected shape. All week lengths at least n contribute only the same horizontal shape, so sum 1..min(r,n-1) and add that single case when available.
The explicit target bound is only 300, so descending 0/1 subset-sum counting is exact, efficient, and distinguishes equal-weight portions by their item identities.
Store each prefix minimum index on the pile, choosing the latest index on ties. A pickup reports the number above that index and removes exactly that suffix; zero-exercise books never enter the pile.

Any achievable maximum is a subset sum of operations covering one position. Conversely selecting only such covering operations makes that position attain the sum and nowhere exceed it. Segment-tree path knapsacks enumerate these sums with immutable integer bitsets.

Optimal one-dimensional median clusters are contiguous after sorting. Prefix sums evaluate median deviation costs, and their Monge property enables divide-and-conquer DP over the bounded number of colors.
